plan.selection: Fixed3 medians, cyclic arm order; all observations retained, no threshold-based repeat or pooling.
plan.runtime: Ordinary fresh process, user cycles/instructions/branch-misses in one complete CPU4 group; includes startup/JIT. CoreMark100000 uses >=10s guest loop; other times whole child.
plan.compile: Separate decode-timing/qualified FEX byte-probe; same input, CoreMark20. Include complete existing compile window, exclude only byte parser for comparison. FEX final native arena destruction is outside older logical working buffer release probe.
plan.fex_revision: a156752fae3a4f65fefb1ed95af980bcdfac43d7 + fixed Android patch; default multiblock and TSO, AVX/AOT/object cache disabled
plan.x87_oracle: exit-only inherited fixture, not full numerical proof

notes.selection: Fixed three-observation medians; every value/range retained. No fastest selection, pooling or significance claim.
notes.representative_stages: Each stage row is one actual observation whose total excluding byte decode equals that arm's median total. Stage medians are not assembled into a synthetic sample.
notes.formal_clocks: Formal compile and paired compile use the original --decode-timing protocol, with compile details disabled. Runtime records have both diagnostic clocks disabled.
notes.detail_clocks: The 18 opt-in --compile-details observations are a separate diagnostic set and never enter formal totals or ratios.
notes.formation: formation_ns includes the byte parser. formation_excluding_byte includes normalization/admission/CFG work; it is not a pure normalization measurement.
notes.fex_allocation: FEX RA is nested in PassManager but assigned to allocation_and_encoding using exclusive remaining_ticks; it is never also charged to optimization.
notes.release_endpoints: SVM includes native-owner release. FEX logical_work_buffer_release is a logical work-buffer release and excludes final native arena destruction. These endpoints remain different.
notes.runtime_scope: CoreMark seconds cover its validated 100000-iteration guest loop. Other seconds include fresh process/startup/JIT/teardown. PMU covers the inherited user group on the wrapper plus descendants; the private FEXServer is outside it.
notes.parent_comparison: Current-run paired records are the controlled parent/candidate subset. Prior formal records provide separately labelled quality-count context, not pooled timing samples.
notes.x87: The inherited x87 fixture has exit-only validation, not an independent full numerical oracle.
notes.excluded_candidate: The pre-dedup directory is never traversed or loaded by this script.
